title: MH17 Shootdown Tracker Update — May 16, 2026
summary: Three new events added covering April–May 2026 MH17 developments. A Dutch court ruled on April 21 that the government may keep cabinet documents from the days after the crash confidential, rejecting media freedom-of-information requests from NOS, RTL, and Volkskrant. On April 24, Piet Ploeg — chairman of the MH17 victims' families foundation who lost three relatives in the crash — was awarded a Knight's honour in the Order of Orange-Nassau during the Netherlands' King's Birthday honours. The landmark July 2025 ECHR ruling finding Russia legally responsible for MH17 was added to the timeline alongside Girkin's January 2024 Russian domestic extremism sentence of 4 years.
